source_text: Design a compact desktop platform-lifting device enclosed within a housing. The user should rotate an external hand crank to raise and lower an internal platform. The platform should move approximately 80-100 mm and support a payload of approximately 1 kg. The mechanism should remain enclosed within the housing during normal operation. The product should be safe to use, mechanically plausible, easy to assemble, and practical to manufacture. Avoid obvious jamming or unstable operation.
product_intent: A compact desktop platform-lifting device that enables manual lifting and lowering of a platform within a housing through external hand crank rotation while maintaining enclosed operation.
user_intent_summary: Design a compact desktop platform-lifting device with an external hand crank that raises and lowers an internal platform by 80-100 mm to support 1 kg, keeping all mechanisms enclosed during operation.

clauses.text: Design a compact desktop platform-lifting device enclosed within a housing
The user should rotate an external hand crank to raise and lower an internal platform
The platform should move approximately 80-100 mm
The platform should support a payload of approximately 1 kg
The mechanism should remain enclosed within the housing during normal operation
The product should be safe to use, mechanically plausible, easy to assemble, and practical to manufacture
Avoid obvious jamming or unstable operation
Continuous or intermittent lifting is acceptable
Multiple shafts, bearings, guides, and supports are allowed

assumptions.statement: The hand crank rotation will produce sufficient mechanical advantage to lift the specified payload over the required distance

unknowns.subject: mechanical advantage required for hand crank operation

unknowns.subject: required housing dimensions

Payload capacity depends on the hand crank rotation mechanism

discovery_outcomes.reason: All clauses from request and clarifications were identified and classified
Both user intent summary and product intent were written
All functional, performance, safety, usability, and manufacturing requirements derived from clauses

Dependencies between requirements were identified and documented
Two realistic operating scenarios derived from the request

Three unknowns identified that cannot be determined from the request alone
